title: Two Sum
prompt: Return indices of two numbers that add up to target. Exactly one solution. Prefer O(n) with a Map.
explanation: Store value→index as you scan. For each number, check if target-num was seen.

title: Valid Anagram
prompt: Return true if t is an anagram of s (same letters, same counts).
explanation: Count chars in s, decrement with t. Length mismatch is an early exit.

title: FizzBuzz
prompt: Return string[] for 1..n: multiples of 3→Fizz, 5→Buzz, both→FizzBuzz, else the number as string.

title: Max Subarray (Kadane)
prompt: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum. Example: [-2,1,-3,4,-1,2,1,-5,4] → 6.
explanation: At each index, either extend the previous run or start fresh at nums[i].

title: Reverse Words
prompt: Reverse word order. Trim extra spaces. '  hello   world  ' → 'world hello'.
explanation: trim, split on whitespace runs, reverse, join with single spaces.
